name: Tsubasa no Shintai Kensa
source:
Tsubasa is new at her all-girl school, but things are going well! She's making friends and having a lot of fun. Until her teacher says she's got to get a physical. And for some reason, he's the one giving it... Tsubasa is embarrassed, but what choice does she have?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE272124.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
小翼是女子学校的新生，但一切进展顺利！她正在交朋友并且玩得很开心。直到她的老师说她必须去体检。出于某种原因，他是给予的人……翼感到尴尬，但她有什么选择呢？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE272124.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
